title: Visa to deliver rewards, fan experiences for BTS' 'Arirang' tour
summary: Visa has announced a collaboration with Philippine card issuers to offer promotions, rewards and exclusive fan experiences to Filipino fans in connection with BTS' 'Arirang' world tour.
